_what: How this Mac is held quiet for a session (computer/hold-this-mac.mjs, tools tool:hold-a-device-quiet, tool:release-a-device, tool:device-holds and tool:focus in computer/mac-tools.json). A hold is { id, apps, only?, focus, until }: while it lasts, the apps it names are asked to quit whenever they open (a hold with `only` instead closes every app but those and `always_open`, for a session where one thing is all that is left open), and Focus is on when it asked for Focus; at `until` it ends by itself. `folder` is under the person's home and keeps holds.json and the shortcuts this Mac signs. `watch_seconds` is how often open apps are checked while a hold lasts; `longest_hours` the longest a hold may last, so a hold can never keep the person out of their own Mac. `always_open` are apps no hold ever closes by name (the Mac's own parts, the terminals the person's work runs in, and the Mac's own call apps, whose microphone a system service holds for them so their calls are not seen as theirs); `keep_open_rows` adds every app named by a row of the file `from` (computer/computer-sources.json `sources`) for which any `where` test ({ field, equals }) holds: the AI apps (category AI) and any app a row marks `runs_ais` (a browser the person's AIs work in), each known by its bundle path, the bundle's file name and its label, so a new AI app is one row there and no hold ever closes it. A running app is compared by every identity it has (shown name, bundle file name, executable, bundle id, bundle path). `spare_while_using` are resources (from the Mac's power assertions, `Resources:`) an app is never closed while using: `audio-in` keeps a live recording or call going until it ends. `focus.shortcuts` are the Shortcuts that switch Focus, each a Shortcuts file as DATA: a shortcut this Mac does not have yet is signed and opened for the person to add with one press.

words.held: This Mac is held until {until}: {apps} close whenever they open{focus}.
words.held_only: This Mac is held until {until}: only {apps} stay open{focus}.
words.released: This Mac is free again: {apps} can open{focus}.
words.holding: {count} hold(s) on this Mac; the last ends at {until}.
words.until_needed: Say until when, as a date and time, or minutes from now.
words.too_long: A hold lasts at most {hours} hours, so it ends at {until} at the latest.
words.add_shortcut: Press Add Shortcut in the Shortcuts window that just opened (once on this Mac), then Focus switches by itself.
